Subject: Privacy routing check — DPA/SCC selection & controller role capture

Hi Liam —

Really appreciated the demo today. Quick recap and next steps on the privacy/compliance side so your legal and security teams can triage: 

- BrightPath asked for confirmation on our SOC 2 status, an editable DPA, and guidance on which SCC module you'd expect us to use (Controller vs Processor flavors).
- You mentioned that BrightPath will need clarifying language around data residency for EEA patients — noted.

Proposed next steps:
1) I can share a short package (SOC 2 summary, DPA template, and our preferred SCC module) so you can route to security/legal.
2) If useful, we can run through a quick 20-min alignment call with your security lead to confirm the controller/processor mapping and any bespoke clauses.

Looping in Markus (sales lead) and Monica (customer success) so we have handoffs covered. Markus — want to confirm whether we should include a formal mutual action plan / timeline here or keep it lightweight?

Liam — if you can confirm the names/emails for your security and legal contacts I’ll attach the package and ask David from security/legal for the SOC 2 coverage details.

Thanks,

Grace O'Connor
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment stubs: redwood-soc2-report-summary.pdf (summary), redwood-dpa-template.docx (editable)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@brightpathhealth.com>, BrightPath Health Security <security@brightpathhealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T15:45:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Privacy routing check — DPA/SCC selection & controller role capture

Thanks Grace — great demo and helpful overview. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: we generally need the latest SOC 2 type II or at least a recent summary with scope. Please include what systems/environments are covered (hosted vs private).
- DPA: editable is good — legal will redline. Key ask: we generally treat patient data as Controlled Health Information; we need to confirm if BrightPath would be a Controller and Redwood a Processor for the features we saw (real-time inference on patient data).
- SCCs: our GDPR counsel prefers Module Two (Processor) in most SaaS cases but can consider Module One if there are cross-border controller-controller arrangements.

Security contacts: 
- Sofia Martinez (security lead) — sofia.martinez@brightpathhealth.com
- security@brightpathhealth.com (shared inbox for evidence)

If you can send the package I’ll route to legal and Sofia. We’d like to kick off the vendor security questionnaire as well — is there a spreadsheet or form you prefer?

—Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Partnerships, BrightPath Health
liam.oconnor@brightpathhealth.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightpathhealth.com>

Date: 2026-08-04T16:00:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Privacy routing check — DPA/SCC selection & controller role capture

Perfect — thanks for the contacts, Liam.

David — can you confirm SOC 2 coverage and attach the summary? Also please attach the DPA template and our standard vendor security questionnaire (spreadsheet).

Markus / Monica — to your point, Markus, let's keep the initial exchange lightweight: 1) send package, 2) BrightPath routes to legal/security, 3) 20-min follow-up alignment if legal requests changes. Monica — will you own the MAP if we get to a contract stage?

Liam — we have a short questionnaire (xlsx) that covers infosec, encryption, key management, and data flow diagrams. I’ll ask David to drop the files and a link to the evidence folder for SOC 2.

Thanks —
Grace
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.inference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>, markus_klein@redwood.inference.com, monica_patel@redwood.inference.com
Date: 2026-08-04T16:30:00-04:00
Subject: Redwood security package & next steps (SOC 2 + DPA + vendor questionnaire)

Hi Liam / Sofia / BrightPath team —

Following Grace's note, attaching a short package to help your security and legal review: 

Attachments (stubs):
- redwood-soc2-report-summary.pdf — SOC 2 Type II summary (last audit: May 2026). Coverage: hosted API endpoints, inference runtime, control plane (excludes on-prem private deployments).
- redwood-dpa-template.docx — editable DPA we typically start from; highlights include permitted processing, security measures, subprocessors list (appendix), and standard breach notification timelines.
- vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx — our standard 60-question security intake covering architecture, encryption, logging, and incident response.

Quick answers to the items you raised: 
- Controller/Processor mapping: for the scenario in the demo (BrightPath sending EEA patient data for inference, Redwood returning model inferences), BrightPath is the Controller; Redwood acts as Processor. If BrightPath intends to use Redwood to enrich or otherwise change the data flows such that Redwood directs processing, we should revisit.
- SCC module recommendation: Processor scenario → Module Two is typical. We can supply language compatible with Module Two in the DPA and draft SCCs.
- SOC 2 coverage: as noted above; private on-prem deployments are out of scope for that audit. For Dedicated/Private customers we provide additional attestation details on request.

Next steps suggested:
1) BrightPath legal reviews the DPA template and returns redlines to this thread or via DocuSign link (if preferred).
2) Sophie/Security to complete vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx and drop evidence to the shared inbox. We can triage questions live — happy to schedule 20 minutes this week.
3) If there are specific SCC module preferences, call that out in the redlines — we’ll align language accordingly.

Shared evidence folder (read-only): https://drive.google.com/u/0/drive/folders/1a2B3cRedwoodSecurityQNA
HubSpot reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/contact/7654321

Feel free to flag anything that needs extra detail.

Regards,
David Kim
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.inference.com
